sections.title: Overview
content: WaveWarp is an experimental Schwung sound generator built from the GPLv3 Vital source code.
It does not bundle Vital factory presets, banks, skins, or Vital branding assets.
This build does include a small bank of CC0 third-party presets with attribution kept in the module package.

sections.title: Bundled Presets
content: Bundled presets come from Abstraction Mage's Vital preset pack, distributed under CC0 1.0.
Attribution and source details are included under the module's docs folder out of respect for the original author.

sections.title: Current Scope
content: WaveWarp exposes a reduced parameter set focused on oscillator shape, voice envelope, mix, macros, and a small FX section.
Use the preset browser in Schwung to reach the bundled sounds quickly, then tweak from the hardware controls.
